text:
kevin: Quick alert from the LangChain + Next starter test matrix: our eval harness is intermittently failing when the sample is deployed to Vercel edge. Appears auth -> retry -> rate pattern.

sara: Saw that too during yesterday's bootcamp run. Local node target is fine, edge shows 401 then immediate retry spikes to 429.

julia: Which SDK are you using in the example? JS or Python client?

kevin: JS: @redwood/sdk-js@0.9.2-rc. Example path: /examples/next-langchain-starter. We inject RW_API_KEY via middleware cookie and edge worker. Logs: 
```
WARN auth: token header empty
INFO request -> attempt 1
ERROR auth: 401 Unauthorized
retrying request (no delay)
ERROR rate: 429 Too Many Requests
```

morgan: Noticed a pattern where the edge runtime reuses connections and the auth header sometimes isn't propagated on the first connection handoff. Python tests hit the same harness but don't reproduce.

sara: I added a tiny delay (50ms) before the first real eval call and failures dropped dramatically in my repro.

julia: Could be the SDK fetch wrapper's header mutation race. We recently added fast connection pooling in the JS client.

infra-bot: CI | preview-deploy #512 failed smoke: https://ci.internal/redwood/preview/512 - attached logs.

kevin: Proposed quick fixes: 1) update example to use client option keepAlive: false 2) add a preflight auth ping in example startup 3) mild exponential backoff in eval harness.

sara: For onboarding docs, add a "Edge runtime troubleshooting" block: list the three workarounds + link to SDK issue. That should help bootcamp folks.

morgan: Filed SDK issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/4599 with failing repro + curl traces. Added failing unit that runs under the Vercel edge runtime in our CI worker.

julia: FYI I pushed a small patch to the example demonstrating the auth ping + backoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/782.

kevin: Nice. Can we also tag the sample README with "edge-known-quirk" and add a short troubleshooting FAQ? Bootcamp instructions can reference it.

sara: Yes. I'll prep the README patch and a tiny note in the bootcamp slides.

devbot: note | smoke-monitor: scheduled rerun in 2h for preview/512.

kevin: Follow-ups: land example PR, merge README change, add a CI smoke deploy step for examples that runs the eval harness on preview deploys. We should also triage whether the keepAlive tweak needs a permanent fix in the SDK (parity investigation JS vs Python).
